page_title: LEC 0-4 INT | Lecce v Inter 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Livio Marinelli is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Some neat passing and movement from Lecce as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 12:10.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rares Burnete (Lecce) replaces Nikola Krstovic.
85' The Inter players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
83' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Tete Morente is replaced by Jesper Karlsson (Lecce).
82' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Mehdi Taremi (Inter) for his blatant foul.
79' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' 7:0 – the corner kicks stats.
76' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

75' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the top right corner, but is stopped by a great save from Yann Sommer, and the score doesn't change. Lecce win a corner.
75' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
75' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kristjan Asllani (Inter) replacing Davide Frattesi.
73' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is caught offside!
72' Substitution. Balthazar Pierret is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
71' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
71' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
70' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
69' Lecce are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
67' Wow, what an escape. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
66' Marcus Thuram (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:7.
62' Substitution. Denzel Dumfries walks off the pitch and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
61' 0 - 4 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mehdi Taremi (Inter) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone no chance!
61' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

60' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Livio Marinelli stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Inter!
59' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
58' The game has come to an end for Henrikh Mkhitaryan. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolo Barella (Inter).
57' 0 - 3 Denzel Dumfries (Inter) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top left corner.

56' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
55' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Yann Sommer is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

53' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate at all and the ball went way wide of the right post. What a miss that is!
52' One of the Lecce players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
50' Lecce are seeing far more of the ball now.
48' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is replaced by Ylber Ramadani.
46' Simone Inzaghi has made a change at the break. Yann Bisseck has come on in place of Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The fouls committed statistics – 9:6.
41' Lecce have a corner.
39' 0 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the roof of the net.

37' Matteo Darmian (Inter) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Livio Marinelli blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
34' Some great controlled play and passing from Lecce. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Simone Inzaghi is stunned as referee Livio Marinelli shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
30' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
29' 3:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Inter players look gutted.
26' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
25' It's in the back of the net! Marcus Thuram sprays a pass out to Davide Frattesi (Inter), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:2.
24' Carlos Augusto (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
24' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
21' Marcus Thuram (Inter) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
20' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' The percentage of ball possession is – 58:42.
16' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Livio Marinelli blows the whistle, Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is penalised for a foul.
12' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
9' A dangerous looking corner kick from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is cleared to safety by the defence.
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Thuram feeds Davide Frattesi (Inter), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
5' Inter players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' Surely that's handball by one of the Lecce players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli will officiate today.
